answer: Because the voyage stake is held until the zenith settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the velvet audit lists each exposure. An attester must stake 37% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer costs proportionally more than endorsing a trivial one. A farm running 160 keys therefore pays that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation inexpensive. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
